According to Appendix A.2 (Training Details, p. 13):

- **Learning rate:** Fixed at 3 × 10⁻⁶ for RL (p. 13).
- **Rollouts per prompt:** G = 16 rollouts were generated per prompt for group-based relative reward estimation (p. 13).
- **KL penalty:** None. The authors disabled the KL divergence penalty in the loss function for their analysis (p. 13).

Other details from the same section:
- GRPO was run with the VeRL framework (p. 13).
- Sampling temperature was 0.6 and top-p was 0.95, following the official DeepSeek configuration (p. 13).
- Maximum output length was 8K tokens (p. 13).

The adaptation phase of Adapted Parallel-RL also uses G = 16 rollouts per prompt (p. 26).
